read: PIOC fell -5.8% today on a 1.24x volume surge, the sharpest single-day move in this dossier, yet still closed above both SMA20 (Rs279.59) and SMA50 (Rs273.5) at Rs282.83. RSI14 is neutral at 52.3 and the 20-day return remains positive (+4.75%), but the 5-day return has flipped to -1.09%. Price is 6.16% below its 20-day high (~Rs301), so today's drop is a sharp momentum break inside an otherwise intact medium-term uptrend structure -- worth watching for confirmation either way.
liquidity_note: Avg daily traded value of Rs134.1m is healthy for PSX -- a position of typical desk size could be entered or exited cleanly.
